skill2: Activates if Shopping is at max stacks when Full Burst ends. (max-stack precondition on the Burst Gauge filling speed rider is not gated — no maxStacks-reached block gate exists in the schema)
burst: Attract: Taunts all enemies for 5 sec.

caveats: ⚑ skill2 Shopping stack trigger: kit says 'when an ally uses a Burst Skill' — modeled as burstCast on ANY ally (the engine's burstCast trigger is owner-cast-keyed). If the engine keys burstCast to the OWNER only, this UNDER-fires by ~3-4x per rotation; a stageEnter-per-stage triple-block would over/under-fire differently. Unmeasured.

⚑ skill2 max-stacks precondition on the Burst Gauge rider is NOT gated: with 3 burst casts per rotation the 4-stack cap (20s duration) is reached during rotation 2 and holds thereafter, so the rider is modeled as always-on from the first fullBurstEnd. This OVER-credits the first ~1-2 rotations' gauge.

⚑ Burst Gauge filling speed ▲7.9% mapped to burstGenPct (the unit's own gauge contribution scaler) applied to all allies. Whether the engine's burstGenPct is per-unit-contribution or a global fill-rate scaler determines whether this is faithful.

defPct is documented inert in v1 (self DEF does not affect own damage). Both DEF lines are kept for kit completeness / a future consumer, per the HARD RULE that DEF/HP lines are not skippable — they may drive a teammate's DEF-scaling conversion.

The burst heal is modeled as 10 recovery events over 10 sec (ticks:10) so on-recovery consumers (e.g. a Crown-style 'when recovery takes effect' partner) stay refreshed; no HP amount is modeled. The 50.47%-of-attack-damage magnitude is not representable.
Taunt is skipped: the v1 boss deals no damage and there is no aggro model, so a taunt has no damage-relevant channel.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Rupee: Winter Shopper is an AR/Electric/Defender Burst I. Her kit carries NO damage effects at all — it is entirely DEF, heal/taunt, reload speed, burst-gauge, and a Burst-Stage-1 re-entry. The two damage-relevant channels are (a) burst Reload Speed ▲63.17%/10s to all allies, which is a weapon-state modifier and therefore IS damage (it gates shots fired — HARD RULE 6), and (b) the reenterStage:1 rotation effect, which lets a second Burst I unit also cast at stage 1 and can materially change the rotation. The Shopping stack and Burst Gauge filling speed lines feed rotation via gauge rate. Both DEF lines (S1 last-bullet 19.02%/5s, S2 Shopping 1.33%×4/20s) are modeled as defPct even though defPct is inert in v1 — DEF lines are never auto-skipped (tandem/cross-unit rule), and dropping them would erase the kit from the file. All three slots authored; skipped lines are listed verbatim in `unmodeled`.
